|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Use The Force]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-04-Use_The_Force-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]; no published image shows this text). The current text is [[Use The Force (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Use The Force]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = number of cards stacked on Communing: Peek at the top card of any deck or pile; may then shuffle it. OR Draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. OR Retrieve 1 Force. OR Activate X Force. OR Your next destiny draw this turn is +X.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 6, slip 34 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “where X = number” to “where X = the number”, “pile; may then shuffle” to “pile: may then shuffle”, “this turn is +X” to “is + X” and set the options in lower case (“peek”, “draw 2 cards from reserve deck”, “retrieve 1 force”, “activate X force”, “your next destiny”): “Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = the number of cards stacked on Communing: peek at the top card of any deck or pile: may then shuffle it. OR draw 2 cards from reserve deck. OR retrieve 1 force. OR activate X force. OR your next destiny draw is + X.”.<ref name="cl-1273_34-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Use The Force (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-usetheforce-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = number of cards stacked on Communing: Peek at the top card of any deck or pile; may then shuffle it. OR Draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. OR Retrieve 1 Force. OR Activate X Force. OR Your next destiny draw this turn is +X.” '''What changed:''' “Your next destiny draw this turn is +X” has “this turn” again (the card list: “your next destiny draw is + X”), and the sheet's capitals and punctuation return (“where X = number of cards”, “Peek … pile; may then shuffle it”, “Draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck”, “Retrieve 1 Force”, “Activate X Force”). The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual7-Light) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual7-Light">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual7-Light/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; like the slip, it prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Use The Force (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 37)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=37, page 37. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=37 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = number of cards stacked on Communing: Peek at the top card of any deck or pile; may then shuffle it. OR Draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. OR Retrieve 1 Force. OR Activate X Force. OR Your next destiny draw this turn is +X.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; like the slip, it prints no slip number. GEMP's current card plays this text: the destiny bonus lasts only this turn (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
